cond_0001.intro: The Engineering Project Manager coordinates engineering efforts with the [Company name masked] engineering team and/or third-party engineering that provides designs of utility scale wind/solar/BESS power plants and associated transmission/distribution systems.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Identifies scope, develops schedules, and coordinates the engineering and design activities for:
Early-stage development projects.
Major bid/Request for Proposal (RFP) opportunities.
Engineer, Procure, Construct (EPC) construction projects.
Establishes, communicates, and manages project engineering budget, schedule and scope expectations.
Creates and maintains Request for Information (RFI) register with the document control system (Procore).
Performs review of designs provided by Engineer of Record for compliance to technical specifications/requirements/scope of work.
Identifies and scopes an engineering peer review of Engineer of Record design(s) with the [Company name masked] engineering team (EPC and Balance of Plant (BOP)/bid-build).
Seeks continuous improvement opportunities for value engineering and efficiencies in design.
Identifies and quantifies potential risks, contract clarifications, and exclusions.
Facilitates handovers to project teams when projects are won or transition to late-stage development Design engineering/construction phase.
Coordinates and hosts engineering kick off meetings (client and internal).
Identifies and coordinates with outside engineers for services on projects.
Works with Assistant Engineering Project Managers (AEPMs) on assigned projects (EPC, bid-build, development, major bids) to build their skillsets and abilities including:
Provides tasks and assignments that challenge and stretch AEPMs responsibilities.
Provides guidance to AEPMs to build confidence and allow AEPMs to learn through project management activities.
Attends work regularly and punctually, as scheduled or expected.
Complies with Employee Handbook, Code of Conduct and Company Policies & Procedures.
Additional Responsibilities:
Presents, supports, and leads-by-example with a safety and quality-oriented attitude.
Coordinates and hosts engineering kick off meetings (client and internal).
Assists Project Manager in establishing Job codes / Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) and Project creation wizard (create folder structure and work order) for design/construction phase.
Assists construction project coordinator to set-up document control system (Procore).
Manages technical documentation, drawings, specifications, submittals, and transmittals within the document control system (Procore).
Maintains upkeep of design change log for periodic distribution to the Project Manager.
Sets up and coordinates technical design review meetings.
Sets up and coordinates Safety Thru Design review meetings.
Schedules and supports organizing site visits for Engineering.
Assists Procurement with coordination of product and shop drawings submittals to the Engineer of Record for approval and client acceptance.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Construction Management or Civil, Structural, Mechanical or Electrical Engineering.
5 Or more years of cumulative engineering experience with relevant wind/solar experience.
Ability to travel domestically 5 to 15%.
Advanced knowledge in Wind/Solar/BESS Power Plant Design.
Advanced knowledge in Wind/Solar/BESS Power Plant Performance Analysis.
Advanced knowledge in Substation/Transmission and Distribution System Design and Operation.
Advanced knowledge in General Civil, Structural, Electrical, SCADA, and Mechanical Design.
Advanced knowledge in General Design for Constructability.
Familiarity with Industry Standards.
Proficiency in MS Office (Project; Excel including charts, graphs, bars, pivot tables, VLOOKUP, COUNTIF, SUMIF, filtering information, VBA and Macros, statistical modeling, forecasting and prediction, advanced formulas; PowerPoint, Word, Outlook, etc.).
Functional competencies include building strategic partnerships, attention to detail, communication, collaboration, and customer focus.
Preferred Requirements:
Master's degree in project management.
Advanced knowledge in communication, internally and externally.
Personnel Management.
Client Management.
Organization.
Project Scheduling Tools.
Fundamental understanding of AutoCAD.

cond_0015.intro: The Engineering Project Manager coordinates engineering efforts with the [Company name masked] engineering team and/or third-party engineering that provides designs of utility scale wind/solar/BESS power plants and associated transmission/distribution systems. A large part of this role involves staying in regular contact with internal teams, outside engineers, clients, and project stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.
cond_0015.responsibilities:
Identifies scope, develops schedules, and coordinates the engineering and design activities for:
Early-stage development projects.
Major bid/Request for Proposal (RFP) opportunities.
Engineer, Procure, Construct (EPC) construction projects.
Establishes, communicates, and manages project engineering budget, schedule and scope expectations.
Creates and maintains Request for Information (RFI) register with the document control system (Procore).
Performs review of designs provided by Engineer of Record for compliance to technical specifications/requirements/scope of work.
Identifies and scopes an engineering peer review of Engineer of Record design(s) with the [Company name masked] engineering team (EPC and Balance of Plant (BOP)/bid-build).
Seeks continuous improvement opportunities for value engineering and efficiencies in design.
Identifies and quantifies potential risks, contract clarifications, and exclusions.
Facilitates handovers to project teams when projects are won or transition to late-stage development Design engineering/construction phase.
Coordinates and hosts engineering kick off meetings (client and internal), actively contributing to discussions and clarifying requirements with all parties.
Identifies and connects with outside engineers for services on projects.
Works with Assistant Engineering Project Managers (AEPMs) on assigned projects (EPC, bid-build, development, major bids) to build their skillsets and abilities including:
Provides tasks and assignments that challenge and stretch AEPMs responsibilities.
Provides guidance to AEPMs to build confidence and allow AEPMs to learn through project management activities.
Presents, supports, and leads-by-example with a safety and quality-oriented attitude.
Assists Project Manager in establishing Job codes / Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) and Project creation wizard (create folder structure and work order) for design/construction phase.
Assists construction project coordinator to set-up document control system (Procore).
Manages technical documentation, drawings, specifications, submittals, and transmittals within the document control system (Procore).
Maintains upkeep of design change log for periodic distribution to the Project Manager.
Sets up and coordinates technical design review meetings.
Sets up and coordinates Safety Thru Design review meetings.
Schedules and supports organizing site visits for Engineering.
Assists Procurement with coordination of product and shop drawings submittals to the Engineer of Record for approval and client acceptance.
Attends work regularly and punctually, as scheduled or expected.
Complies with Employee Handbook, Code of Conduct and Company Policies & Procedures.
cond_0015.requirements:
Bachelors degree or equivalent in Construction Management or Civil, Structural, Mechanical or Electrical Engineering.
Masters degree in project management.
5 Or more years of cumulative engineering experience with relevant wind/solar experience.
Ability to travel domestically 5 to 15%.
Advanced knowledge in:
Wind/Solar/BESS Power Plant Design
Wind/Solar/BESS Power Plant Performance Analysis
Substation/Transmission and Distribution System Design and Operation
Communication, internally and externally
General Civil, Structural, Electrical, SCADA, and Mechanical Design
General Design for Constructability
Familiarity with Industry Standards
Personnel Management
Client Management
Organization
MS Office (Project; Excel including charts, graphs, bars, pivot tables, VLOOKUP, COUNTIF, SUMIF, filtering information, VBA and Macros, statistical modeling, forecasting and prediction, advanced formulas; PowerPoint, Word, Outlook, etc.)
Project Scheduling Tools
Fundamental understanding of AutoCAD
Functional competencies include building strategic partnerships, attention to detail, communication, collaboration, and customer focus.
Comfortable explaining trade-offs and walking stakeholders through decisions in meetings and day-to-day interactions.
We maintain a drug-free workplace. Candidates will be required to pass a pre-employment background investigation and drug test as a condition of employment.

cond_0036.intro: The Engineering Project Manager coordinates engineering efforts with the [Company name masked] engineering team and/or third-party engineering that provides designs of utility scale wind/solar/BESS power plants and associated transmission/distribution systems.
cond_0036.responsibilities:
Coordinates scope identification, schedule development, and engineering and design activities for:
Early-stage development projects.
Major bid/Request for Proposal (RFP) opportunities.
Engineer, Procure, Construct (EPC) construction projects.
Communicates and manages project engineering budget, schedule, and scope expectations together with the project team.
Creates and maintains Request for Information (RFI) register with the document control system (Procore).
Coordinates review of designs provided by Engineer of Record for compliance to technical specifications/requirements/scope of work.
Coordinates engineering peer reviews of Engineer of Record design(s) with the [Company name masked] engineering team (EPC and Balance of Plant (BOP)/bid-build).
Works with the team to identify continuous improvement opportunities for value engineering and efficiencies in design.
Helps identify and quantify potential risks, contract clarifications, and exclusions.
Facilitates handovers to project teams when projects are won or transition to late-stage development design engineering/construction phase.
Coordinates and hosts engineering kick off meetings (client and internal).
Coordinates with outside engineers for services on projects.
Works with Assistant Engineering Project Managers (AEPMs) on assigned projects (EPC, bid-build, development, major bids) to build their skillsets and abilities, including:
Provides tasks and assignments that challenge and stretch AEPMs responsibilities.
Provides guidance to AEPMs to build confidence and allow AEPMs to learn through project management activities.
Presents, supports, and leads-by-example with a safety and quality-oriented attitude.
Assists Project Manager in establishing Job codes / Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) and Project creation wizard (create folder structure and work order) for design/construction phase.
Assists construction project coordinator to set up document control system (Procore).
Manages technical documentation, drawings, specifications, submittals, and transmittals within the document control system (Procore).
Maintains upkeep of design change log for periodic distribution to the Project Manager.
Sets up and coordinates technical design review meetings.
Sets up and coordinates Safety Thru Design review meetings.
Schedules and supports organizing site visits for Engineering.
Assists Procurement with coordination of product and shop drawings submittals to the Engineer of Record for approval and client acceptance.
Attends work regularly and punctually, as scheduled or expected.
Complies with Employee Handbook, Code of Conduct and Company Policies & Procedures.
cond_0036.requirements:
Bachelors degree or equivalent in Construction Management or Civil, Structural, Mechanical or Electrical Engineering.
Masters degree in project management.
5 Or more years of cumulative engineering experience with relevant wind/solar experience.
Ability to travel domestically 5 to 15%.
Advanced knowledge in:
Wind/Solar/BESS Power Plant Design
Wind/Solar/BESS Power Plant Performance Analysis
Substation/Transmission and Distribution System Design and Operation
Communication, internally and externally
General Civil, Structural, Electrical, SCADA, and Mechanical Design
General Design for Constructability
Familiarity with Industry Standards
Personnel Management
Client Management
Organization
MS Office (Project; Excel including charts, graphs, bars, pivot tables, VLOOKUP, COUNTIF, SUMIF, filtering information, VBA and Macros, statistical modeling, forecasting and prediction, advanced formulas; PowerPoint, Word, Outlook, etc.)

Functional competencies include building strategic partnerships, attention to detail, communication, collaboration, and customer focus.

Bachelor's degree in Construction Management or Civil, Structural, Mechanical, or Electrical Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
Around 5 years of cumulative engineering experience, ideally with some wind/solar exposure, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Ability to travel domestically 5 to 15%.
Working knowledge of Wind/Solar/BESS Power Plant Design and Performance Analysis.
Working knowledge of Substation/Transmission and Distribution System Design and Operation.
Familiarity with General Civil, Structural, Electrical, SCADA, and Mechanical Design.
Familiarity with General Design for Constructability and Industry Standards.
Experience with MS Office (Project; Excel including charts, graphs, pivot tables, VLOOKUP, COUNTIF, SUMIF, filtering, VBA and Macros, statistical modeling, forecasting, advanced formulas; PowerPoint, Word, Outlook).
Ability to communicate effectively, internally and externally.
Competencies include attention to detail, collaboration, building partnerships, and customer focus.
Preferred Requirements
Master's degree in project management, or willingness to pursue.
Background in Personnel Management and Client Management.
Experience with Project Scheduling Tools.
Exposure to AutoCAD at a functional level.
Experience working with or mentoring junior engineering staff.

cond_0130.intro: The Engineering Project Manager coordinates engineering efforts with the [Company name masked] engineering team and/or third-party engineering that provides designs of utility scale wind/solar/BESS power plants and associated transmission/distribution systems. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the technical and coordination logic behind power plant engineering and design.
cond_0130.responsibilities:
Identifies scope, develops schedules, and coordinates the engineering and design activities for:
Early-stage development projects.
Major bid/Request for Proposal (RFP) opportunities.
Engineer, Procure, Construct (EPC) construction projects.
Establishes, communicates, and manages project engineering budget, schedule and scope expectations.
Creates and maintains Request for Information (RFI) register with the document control system (Procore).
Performs review of designs provided by Engineer of Record for compliance to technical specifications/requirements/scope of work.
Identifies and scopes an engineering peer review of Engineer of Record design(s) with the [Company name masked] engineering team (EPC and Balance of Plant (BOP)/bid-build).
Seeks continuous improvement opportunities for value engineering and efficiencies in design.
Identifies and quantifies potential risks, contract clarifications, and exclusions.
Facilitates handovers to project teams when projects are won or transition to late-stage development Design engineering/construction phase.
Coordinates and hosts engineering kick off meetings (client and internal).
Identifies and coordinates with outside engineers for services on projects.
Works with Assistant Engineering Project Managers (AEPMs) on assigned projects (EPC, bid-build, development, major bids) to build their skillsets and abilities including:
Provides tasks and assignments that challenge and stretch AEPMs responsibilities.
Provides guidance to AEPMs to build confidence and allow AEPMs to learn through project management activities.
Presents, supports, and leads-by-example with a safety and quality-oriented attitude.
Assists Project Manager in establishing Job codes / Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) and Project creation wizard (create folder structure and work order) for design/construction phase.
Assists construction project coordinator to set-up document control system (Procore).
Manages technical documentation, drawings, specifications, submittals, and transmittals within the document control system (Procore).
Maintains upkeep of design change log for periodic distribution to the Project Manager.
Sets up and coordinates technical design review meetings.
Sets up and coordinates Safety Thru Design review meetings.
Schedules and supports organizing site visits for Engineering.
Assists Procurement with coordination of product and shop drawings submittals to the Engineer of Record for approval and client acceptance.
Attends work regularly and punctually, as scheduled or expected.
Complies with Employee Handbook, Code of Conduct and Company Policies & Procedures.
cond_0130.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Construction Management or Civil, Structural, Mechanical or Electrical Engineering.
5 Or more years of cumulative engineering experience with relevant wind/solar experience.
Ability to travel domestically 5 to 15%.
Advanced knowledge in Wind/Solar/BESS Power Plant Design, Wind/Solar/BESS Power Plant Performance Analysis, and Substation/Transmission and Distribution System Design and Operation.
Advanced knowledge in General Civil, Structural, Electrical, SCADA, and Mechanical Design, General Design for Constructability, and Familiarity with Industry Standards.

People usually grow into this role over time as they build experience with engineering coordination and project delivery in the renewable energy space.
cond_0311.responsibilities:
Identifies scope, develops schedules, and coordinates the engineering and design activities for:
Early-stage development projects.
Major bid/Request for Proposal (RFP) opportunities.
Engineer, Procure, Construct (EPC) construction projects.
Establishes, communicates, and manages project engineering budget, schedule and scope expectations.
Creates and maintains Request for Information (RFI) register with the document control system (Procore).
Performs review of designs provided by Engineer of Record for compliance to technical specifications/requirements/scope of work.

Identifies and quantifies potential risks, contract clarifications, and exclusions.
Facilitates handovers to project teams when projects are won or transition to late-stage development Design engineering/construction phase.
Coordinates and hosts engineering kick off meetings (client and internal).
Identifies and coordinates with outside engineers for services on projects.
Works with Assistant Engineering Project Managers (AEPMs) on assigned projects (EPC, bid-build, development, major bids) to build their skillsets and abilities including:
Provides tasks and assignments that challenge and stretch AEPMs responsibilities.
Provides guidance to AEPMs to build confidence and allow AEPMs to learn through project management activities.
Attends work regularly and punctually, as scheduled or expected.
Complies with Employee Handbook, Code of Conduct and Company Policies & Procedures.
Presents, supports, and leads-by-example with a safety and quality-oriented attitude.
Coordinates and hosts engineering kick off meetings (client and internal).
Assists Project Manager in establishing Job codes / Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) and Project creation wizard (create folder structure and work order) for design/construction phase.
Assists construction project coordinator to set-up document control system (Procore).
Manages technical documentation, drawings, specifications, submittals, and transmittals within the document control system (Procore).
Maintains upkeep of design change log for periodic distribution to the Project Manager.
Sets up and coordinates technical design review meetings.
Sets up and coordinates Safety Thru Design review meetings.

Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Construction Management or Civil, Structural, Mechanical or Electrical Engineering.
